attacker_has_baseline_stake.meaning: attacker holds a baseline stake comparable to passive users before the boundary deposit
attacker_has_baseline_stake.checkpoint: before boundary deposit in epoch e

deposit_at_boundary_minus_one.meaning: attacker deposit occurs at epochTimestampEnd(e) - 1, immediately before end of epoch e

claim_targets_prev_epoch_e.meaning: in epoch e+1 the claim logic targets prevEpoch = e

boundary_boost_exceeds_held_epoch_claim.meaning: the epoch e claim is boosted by the boundary deposit beyond what the same stake held for the epoch would earn (inflated reward capture)
boundary_boost_exceeds_held_epoch_claim.checkpoint: epoch e+1 claimRewards for epoch e

assumptions: The attacker's boundary deposit adds utilization using full msg.value and is counted as full epoch participation (rc_no_time_weighting, rc_direct_epoch_bucket_write).
The claim in epoch e+1 targets prevEpoch = e and rewards are computed from the preserved prior-epoch utilization snapshot.
The baseline stake is a pre-existing position held before the boundary deposit.

unresolved.description: Report does not give the numeric reward differential or the realized unwind cost, so the comparative magnitude of the boost versus held-epoch claim is represented only as a grounded Boolean relation.

limitations: The exact epoch boundary timestamp semantics (epochTimestampEnd(e) - 1) are described but not quantified; the boundary timing is encoded as a grounded occurrence Boolean.
The reward differential and unwind cost values are not stated; only the qualitative boost relation is formalized.
Whether the baseline stake is pre-existing or established in the same run is not fully specified.
